summary: Ivanka Trump, Donald Trump's eldest daughter, was an executive vice president of the Trump Organization and a judge on The Apprentice before serving as an adviser in her father's first administration alongside her husband, Jared Kushner, amid conflict-of-interest concerns over her businesses.
